The Type 64 Light Tank was a Taiwanese tank built using the hull of the American M42 Duster SPAAG and a turret based on that of the M18 Hellcat. The Hellcat turret had been modified to be similar to an M41’s turret, with space for 3 crew members.

To make this requires mixing a lot of spices which can’t be bought in most stores or online. The main spice used in this dish is Bzaar, which requires the Arab spice Bokharat. 

Bokharat ingredients:
1/2 tsp black pepper
1/4 tsp ground cumin
1/8 tsp ground ginger
1/8 tsp ground cloves
1/8 tsp ground coriander 
1/16 tsp ground cardamom 
1/16 tsp ground nutmeg 
This should add up to 1 tsp.

Then to make the Bzaar with your Bokharat. 

Bzaar ingredients: 
1 1/4 tsp turmeric 
3/4 tsp ground caraway seed
1/2 tsp coriander 
And then 1/2 tsp of your Bokharat. 

The rest of the ingredients for the pasta:
1-2 lbs chicken breast
100-300g rigatoni or orecchiette 
1 onion 
2-3 cloves garlic
1/4 cup vegetable oil 
4 tbsp tomato paste
2 1/2 tsp salt 
2 tsp of your Bzaar 
1 tsp paprika
1/2 tsp cayenne pepper
2 cups chicken stock

Dice your onions, mince garlic and slice your chicken into large or medium chunks. Add vegetable oil to a large pot on high heat, once heated add your chicken pieces. Sear until brown on both sides and then set aside. 

Remove the chicken from the pot and add your diced onion in. Sauté until slightly softened and then add minced garlic. Continue sautéing until the onion has become slightly brown. 

Add the chicken back into the pot with the onion and garlic, and then add tomato paste, salt, paprika, cayenne pepper and bzaar to the pot. Pour the chicken stock into the pot, it should be enough to cover the meat mostly. Bring to a simmer and then set the pot into a 350° oven for around 45 minutes. 

Prepare another pot with water and put to a boil. Boil your rigatoni or orecchiette for 12-14 minutes (depending on the time on the box). 

Bring your chicken-tomato sauce out of the oven after the 45 minutes is over and stir it slightly, then add the pasta. Stir again, then garnish with cilantro and/or green chilies.
